title: Rydda'Dar / Trydan Faye's trial
summary: Trydan Faye’s trial culminates in a confrontation with Rydda’Dar.
overview: Trydan Faye’s trial culminates in a confrontation with Rydda’Dar.

sections.title: Encounter guide
bullets: Defeat the trial’s Custodian of Marr to summon Rydda’Dar.
Gather and prepare before triggering the dragon; its availability is limited by a two-hour timer.
After Rydda’Dar falls, speak to Trydan Faye’s projection to complete the trial.

notes: Reviewed against quest source only; encounter behavior, database tuning and availability have not been verified in a live zone. Tactical advice is inferred from the scripted mechanics.
